summary.zh: 按截图或圈选范围做最小 UI 改动
summary.en: Make minimal UI edits from screenshots and selections

description.zh: 在带有截图、元素圈选或标注的改动请求下，定位对应组件并只修改被指出的部分，保留原有样式、行为与无障碍属性。适合以视觉反馈驱动的界面微调。需要提供截图或可选元素信息。
description.en: Finds the component behind a screenshot, selected element or annotation and changes only what was indicated, keeping existing styles, behavior and accessibility. Suits visual-feedback UI tweaks. Requires screenshots or selections.
